/rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so//

/gar gyi nyams dang ldan zhing yan lag bdun ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen gsang ba'i bdag /ma lus 'gro ba rnams kyi sems nyid sa gzhi gtsang ma dag la snang brnyan sna tshogs ston cing bsgyur mdzad pa// de phyir khyod la bdag sogs mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa rnams 'bad cing yang nas yang du gsol 'debs na// thugs rje'i spyan ras mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stong bar du lhun grub 'bad pa med par stsal du gsol// ces mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mngon par mtho zhing*/ lung dang rtogs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dpal la dbang bsgyur ba/ don gnyis kyi 'bras bu rin po che'i gter la longs spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen mchog gis nyid kyi yongs 'dzin bsten tshul/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor skyes tshul/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas snang ba sbyin tshul rnams bskur ces bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa tshig lhug pa zhig cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang bdag nyid skyes pa'i yul/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi gsang ba'i gnas sgru phu zhes bya ba'i gnas su bltams te/ skyes nas mdun pa mngon du phyogs bsam pa rnyed tshun nas/ dad pa dang dwangs ba dang mdun pa rnams chabs cig byung*/ khyad par snying rje che ba yod pa las/ dus gcig gi tshe na 'bri stag 'khrugs te/ mi mang po ma rungs par byas pa'i tshe na/ bdag gis rmi lam du byis pa chung ngu ral pa kham pa yod pa zhig gis/ ri bong gi mgo bcad pa ras khug gang khyer byung nas/ bdag gi mdun du bor nas da dung gsod dam zhes zer ba las/ bdag nyid snying rje mi bzod pa skyes te/ da ma gsod byas pa zhig byung*/ de ni skyes bu dam can yin par mngon te/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i khams nas phebs pa'i dus su/ rdo rje legs pas lam sna mdzad/ ri bong la sogs pas chos zhus pa'ang yod ces/

brgyud pa 'dis bsgrub mi dgos par 'khor bar snang bas/ phyis kyi dus su'ang 'bral med du 'khor zhing gdong grogs sgrub pa zhig byung ba yin/ gzhan sngon gyi bag chags kyis rnam pas/ rab tu byung 'dod pa dang*/ chos nyan bshad kyi tshul/ rde'u rnams la chos 'chad cing*/ khri dang bla ma dang chos nyan gyi rnam 'gyur sogs du ma la rol rtsed byas pa'ang dran zhing*/ ngag tu mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'di blo la byung ba sogs klog pa la skyo ba med de/ yi dam du byas so// de'i rjes su yongs 'dzin da lta'i bar du bsten pa la/ sems ngo sprod pa'i bla ma gsum// gzhung tshogs bstan pa'i bla ma drug man ngag bstan pa'i bla ma gsum dang*/ bcu phrag gcig dang gnyis bsten pas/ rje mnyam med dbang rat+na'i mtshan can de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ snying nas bcos min gyi dad pa brtan po ltem rkyang med pa byung*/ rmongs pa tshu rol mthong ba'i ngor/ ya mtshan pa'i mtshan ma las bdag dad pa ni che/ shes rab ni chung ba lta bur 'dug pas/ thugs dam phreng ba zhig ma gzigs par khyer nas/ lag tu dam por gyon nas 'ongs te/ rang gnas su sleb nas bltas pas mi 'dug pas/ rje nyid la gsol ba btab pas/ phyag tu phyin par byas nas gnang ba zhig byung bas/ mkhyen pa dang rdzu 'phrul dang mdzad pa phul phyin du go ste de tshun nas ci mdzad thams cad la log lta gtan skye ma myong ste/ til+li pas nya gson por bsregs pa dang*/ gu ṇa ri pas bya gshor ba ltar mdzad pa thams cad grub pa thob pa'i rtags su go ste/ rang rdol gyi mos gus skyes te/ dge sbyor la rtsal thon pa'i nges shes skyes pa tsam du byung*/ yang yongs 'dzin dam pa shrī dbang rat+na'i drung du/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhus pa las/ bsam gtan gyi khang bur mun pa la gnas pa'i dus gcig tu gsal snang chen po skyes te/ dwangs cha la gnas khang phyi nang med pa mthong ba zhig byung bas/

bltas pa'i dus su rdo rje 'chang nas bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi gser sku yod pa mthong*/ re re nas bltas pas/ rje mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i sku de yongs 'dzin shrī dbang rat+na dngos su rlung gsal dang bcas te/ bdag la dgyes pa'i ngang du bzhugs pa zhig 'dug pas/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i sprul pa dngos su 'dug snyam pa'i mdun pa skyes/ rje nyid la 'di lta bu'i gsal snang byung ba ji ltar lags zhus pas/ kho bo mnyam med dwags po rin po ches rjes su bzung ba zhig yin/ chos bzhi 'di blo la byung*/ 'di la mkhas pa zhig yin gsungs byung bas/ de nas bzung ste mi brjed pa'i dad pa byung ste/ dge sbyor la bogs thon pa'i nges shes skyes pa byung*/ yang yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog rat+na'i drung du/ lhan cig skyes sbyor zhig zhus pas/ dge sbyor la bogs thon pa byung ba'o// de'i rjes su gzhung tshogs bstan pa'i bla ma drug gi mdun rab tu byung ba dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang*/ sngags sdom sogs blangs te/ sbyang ba ci 'byor gyi thos bsam sgom gsum la mos pa lhur len pa'i bya ba rlabs po che bsgrubs pa dang*/ man ngag bstan pa'i bla ma gsum las phrin las kyi gegs sel/ bogs 'don gsang ba'i gnad yin nam snyam pa rnams grub par rdzogs par byas pa'o// de rnams yongs 'dzin bsten pa'i tshul te dang po'o// ༈ //de'i rjes su bla ma'i drin las rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor skyes tshul ni/ he badz+ra las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bstan pa dang*// bdag gis bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pa ltar yongs 'dzin de rnams kyi gsung gis snying por grub par byas pa las/ thog mar bca' ba lus kyi gnad bstan pa las/ lus 'di khru lus 'tsham pa zhig red pas/

lus gnad ma byang ba'i rnam pa ma byung*/ mig gnad che ba byung*/ sems kyi gnad ma 'phyugs par nyin mtshan skyo dub med par nyams su blangs pas/ dus re zhig gi tshe na/ khams 'dus pa nyams kyi snang ba la/ lus nyams rtsa zug rlung zug ngag nyams smra mchu 'dod pa/ sems nyams dran med du byung ste/ rtogs ldan 'go lha zhes bya ba zhig gis gsol 'debs kyi sgra zhig gis rkyen nas gar song cha med du 'gro snying 'dod de/ dran pas rten ma zin/ ngag 'don dang gtor ma thams cad brjed de/ nyin zhag cha gcig gi bar du lus so// de'i phyi dgong nas/ gnas cha mthug po de cung sangs nas/ dwangs cha'i rnam pa zhig gnas te/ nyin mtshan skyo dub med pa byung*/ lus gnad bshig pa'i dus su/ sna khrag 'byams te sdug bsngal ba dag byung ba las/ yongs 'dzin shrī dbang rat+na de nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang bsrung skud dag snang ba las/ sna khrag 'dzag pa de chad de/ gang tshe chos nyid don la mnyam par sus gzhag pa// de tshe bdud tshogs mi dga' cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// zhes pa ltar bar chad cig yin par go// de nyid kyi gnod par ma nus pa'i rjes su rnam thar chen mor bkod pa ltar/ du ba sogs kyi mtshan rtags lnga/ nyin rtags lnga rnams dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lor bshad pa las ma lus par shar/ yon tan brgyad kyi rnam pa'ang byung bar mngon no// khyad par rtags chen po/ lnga pa rtags su snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes pa'i rtags kyi ngang nas ma g.yos par gnas pa byung ba las/ yongs 'dzin shrī dbang rat+na de nyid shin tu dgyes te/ phyogs rnams su snyan pa'i ba dan sgrog par mdzad pa dag kyang byung ngo*// de lta bu'i nyams snang dag pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i rnam par ma shar ba las/ the tshom dang yid gnyis kyi ngang du 'da' ba las/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog rat+na de nyid kyis gnas lugs lhan cig skyes sbyor du ngo sprad pas/

sems la phan pa rang du byung ste the tshom dang bral ba'o// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs te/ dran 'dzin rtse na gnas su gnas pa de/ yid ches thob pa/ rtse gcig chung ngur go// rtsol bcas kyi dran 'dzin gzhi med du dag ste/ rtsol med shugs 'byung du gnas pa yid ches thob pa/ rtse gcig 'bring du go// yang ngo bo bskyang 'ded du bskyangs pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyi dran pa shor thob dang bcas pa dag ste yid ches sngar 'dris dang 'phrad pa lta bur skyes pa bzo bcos ma dgos te/ rtse gcig chen por go/ de'i ngang nas ngo bo bskyang 'ded du bskyangs pas/ phyi nang med par spros pa dang bral te/ 'di yin med pa'i har sgom zhig byung ste/ spros bral chung ngur go/ de'i ngang nas shor thob dang bral zhing bskyang 'dod kyi bsam pa gzhi med du dag pa/ spros bral 'bring por go// yang chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i stong pa'o snyam pa tsam yang gzhi med du dag ste/ ye dag dgag sgrub ma dgos pa de/ spros bral chen po go// de nyid kyi ngang nas sems kyis brlan zhig skyes te/ gang nas byung cha med pa'i snang bas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di rnams skye med rang sems su go ba ro gcig chung ngur go/ rang sems snang phyogs su go/ gnas lugs rten 'brel du go ba ro gcig 'bring du go// rten 'brel de mnyam nyid du rtogs pas bsal bzhag med par rtogs pa ro gcig chen po go// yang ngo bo bskyang 'ded du bskyangs pas/ rgyu 'bras kyi mig rnyed de sems mnyam par bzhag pa 'di/ ser sna med pa sbyin pa/ le lo med pa brtson 'grus/ khong khro med pa bzod pa/ tshul 'chal dag pa tshul khrims/ g.yeng ba med pa bsam gtan/ 'chal pa dag pa shes rab sogs phar phyin drug sogs rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad mnyam bzhag tu go ba sgom med chung ngu*/ de yang rjes thob mnyam bzhag tu gnas pas/

mnyam rjes kyi gnyis 'dzin gzhi med du dag pas/ gang byas chos su go ba sgom med 'bring por go/ thams cad sems su go bas rtsol sgrub gzhi rtsa bral/ byas tshad chos su song nas 'gro don shugs las byung ba sgom med chen po ste/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ byas na byas tshad chos yin te// ma byas byar med lhun gyis grub// gnyis su med par zung du 'jug /lus kyi sgo nas blo re bde// smras na smras tshad gzhan don grub// ma smras ma brjod yul las 'das// gnyis su med par zung du 'jug /ngag gi sgo nas blo re bde// skyes na skyes tshad bsod nams tshogs// ma skyes skye med ye shes tshogs// gnyis su med par zung du 'jug /yid kyi sgo nas blo re bde// zhes pa'i tshul gyis mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo 'byung lugs rgya chen/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po'i chos mdzod rgya mtsho chen po rnams su blta bar bya'o// 'dir rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor shar tshul rang bzo snyan ngag spangs te snying nas legs par bkod pa'i rim pa ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung tshul ni/ 'bri gung du dgun khrid gcig thon pa'i rjes su nub gcig gi rmi lam du/ bdag thog kha gser khang du snang ba las/ gser khang steng gi gzhal yas khang du/ bla ma 'ba' zhig gis gang nas gral rang byas snang ba thams cad/ dbu la sgom zhwa bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya rkyang pa gsol/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas rol pa 'am mchod phyir thogs pa sha stag rnams tshogs 'dug pa'i nang nas/ bla ma sku smug po 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che lta bu dang bcas pa'ang snang*/ de'i nang nas bla ma gcig mnyam med sgam po rin po che yin zer/ sku sha dkar ba/ zhal dkyus ring ba/ zhal man ring ba/ sgom zhwa bka' rtags kyi rgyan can/ sku chos ngur smrig gsol ba zhig gis/

bdag la mu tig snyim pa gang gnang nas 'di khyod kyi grwa pa yin gsung ba byung bas/ sems can 'ga' la phan pa cung zhig thogs pa 'dra snyam pa'i nges pa'i shes pa zhig byung*/ de'i rjes su yang dgun khrid cig thon pa la/ nub gcig gi rmi lam du/ rang gi lus la rnag khrag bab pa de khang pa zhig gang tsam thon pa rmis te/ sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags su go zhing*/ de'i rjes su'ang nub gcig rmi lam du/ 'bri gung thang 'di thams cad mar me'i kong bu gang sdong ras btsugs pa 'ba' zhig mthong bas/ bdag gis gcig sgron nas des thams cad sgron pa zhig rmis pa 'di 'ang*/ dgun khrid kyi dus yin pas/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig la phan par go ba zhig kyang byung zhing*/ yang re zhig gi tshe na/ sgrub sde'i gnas su 'gro rgyu'i nub gcig gi rmang lam du/ rdza ma mang po me tog rgya men gyis gang nas skyes pa la la shar/ la la 'char rgyu dang*/ la la 'char la khad pa'i gang ba snang zhing*/ bdag kyang lus chos gos dri ma med pa zhig gyon nas 'gro zhing 'dug pa zhig byung bas/ sgrub sde 'di la phan cung zad thogs pa 'dra snyam pa yang byung*/ gzhan pa dngos su bla ma rnams kyis 'gro don bgyis shing*/ khyad par dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la 'bungs zhes yang nas yang du bka'i gnang ba byin pa'o// lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/ spang zungs zhes pa'i gnas su/ yongs su 'dzin pa shrī dbang rat+na'i drung du/ lhan cig skyes sbyor bsgom pa'i dmigs pa'i lung 'dren du/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku 'di ni// 'jig rten gsum po kun nas snang bar byed// dmigs pa de la gang gis sems 'dzin pa// byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya// zhes pa'i skabs su nyin gcig phyed thun zhig la gnas pa las/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan dpe yon tan gyis brgyan pa zhig mthong ba dang*/

dbu ru ka tshal gyi gtsug lag khang du nyin phyed pa'i dus gcig yar gyi nam mkha' 'di nyid la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong shin tu gsal ba zhig zhal mthong zhing*/ gzhan yang dben gnas khra ba kha'i gtsug lag khang du sngags mtshan nyid kyi lha khang mang po mthong ba dang*/ mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du nub gcig gi rmi lam du/ rang nyid kyi lag 'og gnyis su bya rog gdong snum pa legs pa gnyis gnas pa mthong ste/ 'di ni gzhi'i gnas lugs kyi rtsa gnyis la brten pa'i gdong chen mthong bar mngon/ yang thog kha gser khang du ye shes kyi mgon po gtso 'khor rgyas pa ma tshang ba med pa zhig sku mdog ser 'jam du snang bar mjal te/ 'di ni kun+da lus la gnas pa'i dus su mthong bar mngon no// de lta bu rnams las rjes su bzung ba'i mdun pa byas te/ phrin las bsgrubs par byas pa'o zhes pa de/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i rim pa ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //gang zhig rang snying dpang por btsugs te/ nyams myong gdul bya'i don du yi ger bkod pa las/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma mnyes 'khrugs gyur na/ sems can don la dgongs te bzod pa mdzad cing rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ 'di'i dge bas rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal ba myur thob shog// / ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa/ tshig lhug par byas pa 'di nyid/ 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas su sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //
